text:
Zoe Kim: hey all 👋 first day and running into cloud access snags — any quick pointers?
Zoe Kim: 1) GCP: I can't attach billing to project 'redwood-sandbox' (console shows "You need permission to view billing accounts"). 2) AWS: after SSO I can't create roles in eu-west-1 (AccessDenied), my default region is eu-west-1 in CLI.
Chris Lane: welcome Zoe! For GCP billing we route through Finance. Please open an access request at https://access.redwood.com > New Request > Cloud Billing and include project id + billing account id if you have it (BA-xxxx). Tag your manager to speed approval.
Zoe Kim: filed INC-12001 with project redwood-sandbox, left BA blank and tagged my manager.
Ida Park: for AWS region denies, double-check org policy — some accounts block eu-west-1 for new resources. Try `aws sts get-caller-identity` then `aws configure get region` to confirm. If org blocks the region we can request an exception but need business justification.
Zoe Kim: `aws sts get-caller-identity` shows assumed-role/Redwood-Developer/Zoe, region is eu-west-1. The CLI error is: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: iam:CreateRole
Chris Lane: CreateRole is typically restricted to admins. Developers usually get pre-created roles or a service to request one. Which role are you trying to create?
Zoe Kim: just a small test role for a PoC — name redwood-temp-role. I can work around if you prefer to create it for me.
Ida Park: quick option: tell me the exact trust policy and permissions and I can create it temporarily. Also file a short justification in the access ticket referencing INC-12001 so Finance/Security have context for region/role exceptions.
Zoe Kim: added role details to INC-12001 and note about eu-west-1. Trust policy: allow sts:AssumeRole from service account; permissions: logs:CreateLogGroup, s3:PutObject, kms:Encrypt for a KMS key.
Ida Park: got it. Creating role now with a 7-day TTL so you can finish the PoC.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: complete the cloud onboarding checklist: https://onboarding.redwood.com/checklist to avoid delays.
Ida Park: role created: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-temp-role (ttl 7 days). Try your create command again or `aws iam get-role --role-name redwood-temp-role` to confirm.
Zoe Kim: confirmed can see the role and assumed it, thanks! ECR push and small infra tests now work.
Chris Lane: I'll watch INC-12001 for the billing link. If finance approves quickly we can link the project; otherwise we can temporarily run APIs using a finance-owned billing link after approval.
Zoe Kim: finance approved and billing linked — I can see billing and enable APIs now. Thanks everyone for the speedy help :tada:
SSO Bot: Tip: if SSO role assignments don't appear right away, sign out and re-launch the SSO portal or run `aws sso login --profile redwood`.
Zoe Kim: all set, closing the onboarding checklist. Appreciate the help!
